title: Q-CLOCK-LANE-HOOK: run the heal pass from the lane so stale stages are caught within one merge cycle
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:.github/workflows/lane.yml::clock --heal
**Status:** closed

The heal pass (catch-up ticks, settlement by name, escalation; foundation/clockwork.py) runs daily from product-manager.yml and at the end of every executor run. The lane workflow runs after every CI completion, which is the densest beat the system has outside the heartbeat. Run `python3 -m foundation clock --heal --apply` as a last step of lane.yml (token and budget rules as in product-manager.yml) so a stale stage is caught within one merge cycle instead of a day. Adopted from the parallel CLOCKWORK branch (its lane hook).
Paths: .github/workflows/lane.yml (needs-pat), tests/foundation/test_pm.py.
Acceptance: lane.yml carries the step with the Cloudflare token and a timeout; the workflow budget lint passes.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:.github/workflows/lane.yml::clock --heal.

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (7 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): grep:.github/workflows/lane.yml::clock --heal
